audience: teams who collect form submissions with Wufoo

useCases.title: Count a form's entries, all or filtered
useCases.text: Counts the entries of a form, or only those matching filters, and lists forms with the number of entries received today.

useCases.title: Read the latest entries with readable field names
useCases.text: Reads a form's entries with each field shown by its title, such as Email, instead of a Field number. Filters like the Entry Manager are possible.

useCases.title: Read the comments the team left on entries
useCases.text: Lists the comments team members left on a form's entries, for all entries or one, and counts them.

useCases.title: Review reports, their entries and widgets
useCases.text: Lists reports, reads the entries behind one and its chart and big-number widgets, and counts the entries.

useCases.title: Submit an entry to a form
useCases.text: Reads the form's fields, then submits a new entry as if someone filled in the form. It is stored and triggers the form's notifications and integrations.

useCases.title: Add or remove a webhook on a form
useCases.text: Adds a webhook so Wufoo posts each new entry to a URL you give, or removes a webhook with its hash.
